session.version_stamp_note: Prefer stamp in thread/session title or as a single short line above items if the bot needs a version anchor. Never restore old how-to / marks / out-of-scope top or bottom blocks.

items.label: Install lands in the Thornswood Game folder
items.discord_line: Run a fresh install or an update from the launcher. Pass when the game files land in the Thornswood Game folder (often C:\Thornswood\Game), not when Play tries to start from the Steam Skyrim folder itself. Open Settings and confirm the version string looks current. If the launcher points at Steam or the version looks stale, mark Fail and say what you saw.

items.label: Bring it up to date stays quiet
items.discord_line: Use Bring it up to date (or the normal update path) from Diagnostics. Pass when the update finishes without a Windows admin (UAC) prompt and without a black console window. If either appears, mark Fail and say which one.

items.label: Shortcuts keep the right icons after update
items.discord_line: After an update, check the desktop and Start-menu shortcuts for Thornswood. Pass when the icons still look correct, or when Settings Refresh the shortcut icon fixes them without a full reinstall. If icons stay blank or wrong, mark Fail.

items.label: Undeployed collection shows one clear Diagnostics message
items.discord_line: Open Diagnostics and run Scan when the Vortex collection is not deployed (ask staff to set that up if you need it). Pass when you see one clear message that the collection is not deployed, not a long wall of one error per plugin. Do not look for a Mods page - that rail page is gone. If you get a wall of plugin errors for an undeployed collection, mark Fail.

items.label: Offline Play is not called a load-order problem
items.discord_line: Try Play when the live server is unreachable (ask staff to take it down briefly, or for a known bad address). Pass when the message talks about the server not answering or network reachability. Fail when the only message is a load-order or Verify warning while the real problem is that the server cannot be reached.

items.label: Chat fade in Settings
items.discord_line: Open Settings and find Chat fade. Try Never and a timed option (5, 10, 15, or 20 seconds). Send a few chat lines and wait. Pass when the text follows the setting you picked. If you cannot find Chat fade on Settings, mark Fail and say what you see instead.

items.label: Needs bars and the Body page
items.discord_line: Find Show the needs bars on screen in Settings. Turn the bars off, then on. Open K and the Body page. Pass when the bars follow Settings and the Body page shows your needs. If the bars or the Body page do nothing, mark Fail.

items.label: Discord connect before Play
items.discord_line: Try Play when Discord is not connected, or when your Discord account is not accepted yet (ask staff for a test login if you need one). Pass when you get a clear apply message and a working control that opens the Discord invite, and you do not get into the game. With an accepted Discord account connected, Pass when Play starts the normal way.

items.label: Wrong or missing join pass is refused clearly
items.discord_line: Try Play when you have no join pass file, then try again with a wrong join pass (ask staff how to clear or replace the pass file if you need help). Pass when each attempt is refused with one clear sentence you can read, and you do not get into the game. With a valid join pass in place, Pass when Play continues past that check the normal way. If the refuse text is missing, unclear, or you still enter the world, mark Fail and quote what you saw.

items.label: Character creation finishes cleanly
items.discord_line: Make a new character through the normal creation screens, including the face / K panel stage. Pass when you finish and reach the world without force-closing the game (no Alt+F4, Task Manager, or crash to get past that stage). If creation jams, note which screen you were on.

items.label: You arrive clothed after creation
items.discord_line: After you finish creating a character and enter the world, look at yourself. Pass when you are wearing the clothes you stand in for this build (plain starter clothes), not standing naked from a missing dress step. If you look wrong, take a screenshot if you can and say what you saw.

items.label: Crowded town NPCs settle without a lasting pileup
items.discord_line: Walk into a busy town such as Whiterun. Watch guards and other townsfolk for a few minutes. Mark Fail-known if NPCs pile up on you, freeze in stacks, or start mass fights that never settle. Do not mark Pass on this row until staff say world authority is fixed.

items.label: Craft the same thing twice after you respawn
items.discord_line: Respawn, then go to a forge. Bring enough materials for two of the same craft. Craft that recipe once, then craft it again. Pass when both finished items stay in your pack. Forges are live; do not Skip this row. If you cannot find a forge or materials, ask staff where to go and which simple recipe to use.

items.label: Starting gold is 40 once
items.discord_line: On a brand-new character, check your gold the first time you enter the world. Pass when starting gold is exactly 40. Quit to the launcher, come back on the same character, and check again: you must not get another free 40. If your first entry shows a different amount, say whether this was a leftover character before marking Fail.

items.label: Trade gold with someone else
items.discord_line: With a second person online, open trade and move some of your pack gold to them (and back if you like). Pass when both packs update to match the trade, and any fee takes gold away instead of leaving totals wrong. Do not test buying from traders on this row. If you have no second person, ask staff to join you for the trade.

items.label: No free extra gold
items.discord_line: Try a world gold sack or a coin purse that should refuse, or any other usual free-gold grab staff name. Pass when the game refuses with a clear error you can see, and your gold does not silently jump up. Do not test trader shops here.

items.label: Paid carriage or ferry takes your fare
items.discord_line: Take a paid carriage or ferry ride and watch your gold. Pass when the fare comes out of your pack and you do not ride free.

items.label: Quit and relaunch keeps your pack
items.discord_line: Note your inventory and gold, quit to the launcher on purpose, then launch again on the same character. Pass when your pack and gold match what you had, with no extra starting gold added. If something is missing or gold went up, say what changed.

items.label: Refused craft keeps your materials
items.discord_line: Try a craft the game should refuse (wrong profession or rank - ask staff to name one if you need it). Pass when your materials stay in the pack and you see a clear reason it was refused. Do not mark Pass only because a recipe is hidden in the menu.

items.label: K panel shows profession and half
items.discord_line: Open the K panel on a normal character made under the current rules. Pass when you can see both your profession and your half. If the panel is blank, say whether this might be an old leftover character before marking Fail.

items.label: Friend request gives a clear result
items.discord_line: With a second person nearby, send a Friend request and have them Accept or Refuse. Pass when both of you see a clear result, not endless waiting for server. If you have no second person, ask staff to help for this row.

items.label: Trade offer gives a clear result
items.discord_line: With a second person nearby, open Trade and complete or refuse an offer. Pass when both packs and prompts update clearly, not endless waiting for server. If you have no second person, ask staff to help for this row.

items.label: Party menu shows a real state
items.discord_line: Open the party menu alone and with a friend if one is online. Pass when invite, accept, leave, and the current state look clear instead of spinning forever on waiting for server.

items.label: Voice stays connected in range
items.discord_line: Connect voice with a second person nearby and talk, then stay quiet for a short stretch. Pass when voice stays up through that quiet window instead of dropping with no message.

items.label: Voice mute works
items.discord_line: Mute somebody with L while you look at them, or with Mute beside them on P, then unmute them the same way. Pass when their voice follows that mute. Do not mark Pass on text mute, /silence, colored head marks, or launcher speaking lights on this row.

items.label: A client crash leaves a log you can find
items.discord_line: If the game client crashes during play, look for a Crash Logger text log under C:\Thornswood\Profile\MyGames\SKSE (or use Diagnostics Build the report). Pass when there is a clear log or report zip you can point staff at. Full .dmp crash dumps are staff/dev only - do not Fail this row just because there is no .dmp. If there is no crash during your session, leave a note that you did not hit one rather than marking Pass.

items.label: Kick or refuse does not reconnect every few seconds
items.discord_line: Ask staff to refuse or kick you once on purpose, then watch what the launcher does next. Mark Fail-known if it auto-reconnects every few seconds with no clear stop. Do not mark Pass until staff say the refuse path is fixed.

items.label: Install and join copy talks about your own Game folder
items.discord_line: Read the public join or install instructions (site join page or launcher Settings around Thornswood's own Skyrim folder). Pass when they talk about the Thornswood Game folder and do not tell you to always Play from Steam. If the copy still says Steam-only Play, mark Fail and quote the line.
